svg.title: Matsuba's corner frontage on Red Lion Street
svg.desc: An illustration of the slate-painted corner shopfront at dusk: two slate awnings, each spelling MATSUBA in widely spaced white capitals, a glazed door, windows with white and purple orchids on the sill, a lit menu case on the pier, a painted brick plinth and black railings, with red brick and white sash windows above.
